thread:
sam: Heads up — noticed a ~20% p95 latency spike on 8x7B after we rolled the rope-scaling tweak + sliding-window opt to kernel-selector.
anya: saw that in the dashboards. Is it across all routes or just long-context jobs? :thinking_face:
devon: looks correlated with sequences > 1024. Short seqs are fine. Repro locally with loadgen at seq=2048 I get p95 jump from 140ms -> 180ms on A100.
maria: can you paste the kernel selection output? wondering if it's choosing the matmul fallback more often now.
devon: here — profiler excerpt from the failing run:
```
kernel_selector: tier=auto -> chosen=atten_tile_v2
fallbacks: 8 (matmul_kernel) since ropescale=true & windowed_mask=true
KV cache hit_rate: 0.87 -> effective_reloads++
p95 tokens/sec: 1100 -> 880
```
sam: hmm, kernel_selector choosing atten_tile_v2 for long sliding windows when rope-scale is on. That kernel has worse per-token throughput for our kv-layout.
anya: could be interaction with KV tile boundary alignment. When rope scaling shifts positions we might be fragmenting KV tiles -> more kernel handoffs.
devon: I dumped task-level traces, path shows repeated kernel handoff at token ~768, see snippet:
```
[2026-02-26T14:12:03Z] choose_kernel(m7b, seq=2048, ropescale=1) -> atten_tile_v2
[2026-02-26T14:12:03Z] kv_tile_switch -> rebind_kv_cache()
[...]
[2026-02-26T14:12:03Z] fallback->matmul_kernel (higher latency)
```
maria: quick mitigation: force kernel_selector=prefer_kv_aligned for the 8x7b model variant in prod and roll a canary? ops-bot can we schedule a canary? :pray:
ops-bot: scheduled canary deployment to pool "dedicated-8x7b-canary" at 14:40 UTC. Notifying on-call.
anya: good. devon, can you run an A/B on batching heuristics — compare continuous batching vs window-aware slicing? maybe smaller batches avoid the tile boundary churn.
devon: running now. initial microbench: with window-aware slicing (slice_len=512) p95 -> 130ms (better) but throughput drops 8%.
sam: tradeoff acceptable for latency-sensitive routes. We should also check max_position_embeddings handling — if model config uses 4096 but runtime pads to 8192 with ropescale, that might exacerbate tile mismatch.
maria: opened an issue with stack trace and reproducer: https://git.internal/rw/infra/issue/1258
anya: next steps: (1) canary kernel_selector change, (2) experiment batching slice=512 in Optimize suggestions, (3) add a profiler signal to detect kernel handoffs and alert. I'll own (3).
devon: also pushing a small kernel tweak to reduce handoff penalty (fallthrough path). will bench and post numbers.
sam: thanks all. If canary looks good we'll roll to prod and update rollout policy to prefer_kv_aligned for 7b/8x7b families when rope-scaling=true.
maria: note for changelog: mention rope-scaling + sliding-window interplay and kernel handoff mitigation.
anya: :thumbsup: keep updates here.
